name: Mark Carney
quote: Canada is mobilising more than 5,000 firefighters and nearly 300 waterbombers, helicopters, and evacuation aircraft to contain, control, and mitigate the fires. It's an enormous, complex effort that ultimately depends on the courage of the people doing it.

name: David Eby
quote: Homes have been lost, and properties have been destroyed, some people became trapped as conditions changed. To everyone affected, you are not alone. British Columbians are with you.

name: Doug Ford
quote: That kind of rhetoric from President Trump is unacceptable — we're dealing with a natural disaster, not a trade dispute.

name: Donald Trump
quote: We are holding Canada responsible for not maintaining their forests, and this is causing tremendous problems for our Country, costing us billions of Dollars, which must of necessity be added to their Tariffs.

name: Bernie Moreno
quote: Canada needs to be held accountable for allowing these fires to devastate American communities — I'm introducing legislation to sanction the officials responsible.

name: Patty Murray
quote: Cuts to federal wildfire and emergency-response capacity are making it harder — not easier — for our communities to cope with smoke crossing the border, no matter who is fighting the fires.

name: Bernie Sanders
quote: This isn't Canada's fault — it's the fault of a fossil fuel industry that has denied climate science for decades while the planet burns.

name: First Nations Leaders (Joint Statement)
quote: The federal government has a responsibility here, too. We won't accept any jurisdictional dispute. In the year 2026, how could this happen? More importantly, how do we make sure this never happens again?

name: Eabametoong First Nation Leadership
quote: We had to fight for every hour of that airlift — our people should never have had to wait this long to be moved to safety.

name: Canadian Red Cross
quote: Our teams at the Fort William Gardens reception centre are focused on making sure every evacuee has a bed, a meal, and someone to talk to — this has been one of our largest simultaneous deployments in years.

name: CONAFOR Firefighting Contingent
role: Mexican National Forestry Commission Deployment Lead
quote: We came because Canada helped fight our fires in years past — this is what international mutual aid is supposed to look like.

name: Eleanor Olszewski
role: Minister of Emergency Management and Community Resilience, Canada
quote: Wildfire activity has really grown and accelerated significantly since our July update — we're still in the heart of the wildfire season and some communities face difficult conditions.

name: World Weather Attribution Network
quote: Extreme fire seasons like this one are not an anomaly — they are what climate change looks like in Canada now, and they will keep recurring unless warming is curbed.
